04 — BEAUTY MEETS RESTRAINT

Big on feeling.
Light on everything else.

Good motion respects the person on the other side of the screen.

LIVE RENDER MONITOR—FPS on this device

Measured while a 3D scene is visible. Device, browser, and display refresh rate affect results.

01Built, not downloaded.−

Every 3D object is generated in code. No large model downloads or video textures. A shared environment gives the materials their studio finish.

02Motion that listens.+

Pointer and keyboard controls, a pause switch, and automatic reduced-motion support. Animation sleeps when its scene leaves the screen or the tab is hidden.

03Performance is part of the design.+

One active scene at a time, capped pixel density, responsive rendering, and a static fallback. Beautiful interactions should earn every frame.
